proposals.expected_signal: Improved NDCG@10 from more robust user-item representations under full-sort evaluation, with strongest gains on mid-degree users/items and limited training instability.
proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive auxiliary may over-regularize LightGCN embeddings, causing weaker ranking sharpness and no gain if augmented views collapse toward near-identity.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding a lightweight contrastive auxiliary on degree-aware graph dropout views to a LightGCN pairwise-ranking baseline will improve representation quality without changing the evaluation protocol, yielding a higher-utility discovery test than larger architectural changes.
